preconditions.description: The integer N must be between 1 and 4 inclusive.
The integer K must be greater than 1 and less than 10.
The value of K raised to the power of N must be greater than 1 and less than 4096.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string must match the length of the string returned by the function.

postconditions.expression: all(substring in stdout for substring in set(''.join(map(str, range(K))) * N))
postconditions.description: The output string must contain all possible substrings of length N formed from characters 0 to K-1.
The output string must be the string returned by the function.
